result.label: poor
evidence: Regex has no IPv4 presence check: '\b(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})(?!.*\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})'
Agent's own validation showed matches on lines with NO IP and accepted invalid date '1999-13-40'
No month/day range validation (accepts 13 month, 40 day)
No trailing boundary or alphanumeric-guard as required to avoid false matches
result.reason: The regex ignores multiple explicit requirements (IPv4 presence, valid month/day ranges, alphanumeric guards) and only handles the last-date-per-line aspect. It is brittle and matches many false positives, failing to generalize beyond even the trivial case; the visible test failed.
